name: RV There Yet?
notes: Unreal Engine 5. By default the game picks DirectX 12, which fails under Wine. Forced to DirectX 11 through DXVK-macOS with -dx11 (2026-11-08, M4 16 GB): the menu and HUD draw but the 3D scene stays black, and one session crashed about 15 s after loading the map. The log shows the same MoltenVK error as Orcs Must Die 3: a draw using a geometry shader fails ('Fragment input(s) user(locn2) mismatching vertex shader output'), and Metal also lacks the typed storage image formats Unreal's post-processing uses. -FeatureLevelES31 makes the game exit at start-up. These are limits of MoltenVK, not something a recipe can switch off. Multiplayer (Epic Online Services) untested.
